messages:
anya: Heads-up — noticed flaky failures in the onboarding smoke for long-seq models. Splitting this thread to discuss tradeoffs between a fast smoke and the heavy bench runs.

mike: Which failures are flaking? perf or correctness?

anya: Mostly latency spikes in the bench worker when seq_len > 4096, plus a few tokenization mismatches in fp16 runs.

zara: @mike @sam I traced one case — runtime switches kernel path mid-run which invalidates the KV cache; that creates a big tail in latency. I can paste logs.

sam: Can we do a lightweight smoke that pins kernel-paths and only verifies correctness + KV stability? Full perf bench can run async on dedicated nodes.

anya: Proposal: two-stage onboarding. 1) correctness smoke: pinned kernels, fixed seeds, small prompt set — fast. 2) throughput bench: allows kernel exploration but runs later on reserved infra.

mike: Sounds good. Ops ask: make it opt-in via model metadata flag so we don't get false negatives for models that rely on kernel autodispatch.

zara: Also add a quick quantization compatibility check: golden prompt set (~50 examples) with a divergence threshold; if over threshold, fail admission. Cheap and catches bad quantization artifacts.

sam: What should the threshold be? token-level diffs or metric-level (e.g., sacreBLEU / ROUGE) delta?

anya: Start conservative: 3% token-level divergence for the smoke. We'll collect telemetry and tighten later. Add a doc note.

onboard-bot: lint: added flag onboarding.enforce_pinned_kernels to model schema v1.7 — PR #4521 (auto-tagged).

mike: I'll add the opt-in flag and a config snippet for the onboarding CLI:

```yaml
model_schema:
  enforce_pinned_kernels: true
  quant_smoke_size: 50
  quant_delta_pct: 3
```

zara: Make sure the Console surfaces an "Entry gate — pinned kernel smoke" with failure reason and a direct link to logs/artifacts. That helps SRE triage.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll wire the canary so the full bench runs on dedicated infra after the smoke passes. Aim to have the PR and infra wiring by EOD?

anya: EOD for the initial PR works. Follow-up next week to review aggregated metrics and adjust thresholds.
